FeedShelfVisualTests.Capture_cover_shelv.reason: Both source 1600/900 x 1000 sizes preserve two shelves of five original titles/reasons, exact headings/blurbs, installed Steam facts, Hades summary, supplied portrait/hero artwork and fourth-card quick details. Native checks 180..240 px 2:3 covers,18 px gaps and bounded flipped preview, with separate fullscreen 1280/1920 selected-hero/controller navigation and no pointer preview. Capture-enabled frozen source failed because its empty, never-loaded FeedViewModel receives exactly 2 x 5 cards but asserted 12. Root corrected only 12 to 10; all 13 source cases then passed and both widths also passed with supplied artwork. API stable IDs 1..5 replace the source TileFixture reused default identity while preserving both repeated five-card tuples; candidate count remains the original unloaded 0. The unused sixth array entry Tunic stays absent. The source capture supplies the same bitmap for vivid and dormancy floor; native uses the real pipeline, which desaturates never-played unselected covers. Both preview heroes use vivid artwork. This fixture distinction is recorded rather than changing play facts or dormancy styling to force identical colors. The source capture has no sidebar; the real desktop shell leaves less room beside Hades at 1600px, so native asserts the measured side-selection rule, flush anchor and 8px viewport inset rather than hard-coding a side from the isolated capture. Fullscreen capacity is four at 1280px and five at 1920px; controller traversal verifies all five titles/reasons and the paged fifth card before returning to Hades and changing shelves.
